verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents its own batch inference capability, which processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% off serverless prices. That is a genuine first-party bulk operation, but the pack shows only a one-line description and covers inference requests only, not bulk actions on managed resources such as models, deployments or datasets. Missing for 10: details of the batch job workflow (input format, job API, status and result retrieval), bulk management operations across account resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
